steps.eval: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.deal-card')].filter(c => c.querySelector('h3')); const pills = cards.map(c => [...c.querySelectorAll('span[title]')].find(s => /stage [1-5] of 5|^Fund|^Secondary|^Real/i.test(s.getAttribute('title') || ''))); const withPill = pills.filter(Boolean).length; if (withPill < 8) throw new Error('cards with a stage pill: ' + withPill + ' of ' + cards.length); const calder = cards.find(c => /Calder/.test(c.querySelector('h3').textContent)); if (!/series a/i.test(calder.innerText)) throw new Error('Calder does not say Series A'); const lit = calder.querySelectorAll('[data-on="true"]').length; if (lit !== 2) throw new Error('Calder (Series A) lights ' + lit + ' rungs, expected 2'); })()
